name: timeline.layout
title: Timeline layout
summary: Lay scenes out from voice-over lines: cue times, scene lengths, optional beat snapping, music markers and named times. Writes timeline.json and dialogue-clips.json.
description: A pure layout helper. Each scene is as long as its lines plus the lead, gaps and tail you ask for (all zero by default, nothing snapped), or a fixed duration_s. Audio lines are measured at their speech end (Piper leaves trailing silence), not their file length. Optional beat snapping, markers that align the music grid to a scene (the music_offset_s / beatOffset), named times, and a per-frame voice envelope are available when you want them. It never renders or mixes anything; it only computes numbers.

defaults.description: Layout defaults for every scene. All neutral (0, no snapping) unless set.

lead_s.description: Seconds from the scene start to the first line (default 0).

gap_s.description: Seconds between two lines when a line sets no pause_s (default 0).

tail_s.description: Seconds after the last line before the scene ends (default 0).

snap_beats.description: Round every scene length up to a multiple of this many beats (needs grid). null = no snapping (default).

grid.description: Musical grid. Required for snap_beats, for markers and for bar:/beat: times.

preset.description: Named layout preset from presets/timeline/ (for example voice-driven-classic), merged under this request.

scenes.description: Scenes in playback order; each starts where the previous one ends.

id.description: Scene id (letters, digits, _ or -), used by times and markers.

duration_s.description: Fixed scene length in seconds. Overrides the line-driven length and is used exactly (not snapped).

snap_beats.description: Overrides defaults.snap_beats for this scene (null = do not snap this scene).

lines.description: Voice-over lines in order. Omit for an empty scene or a fixed duration_s scene.

audio.description: Audio for the line: a workspace path, job:<id>/<output> or pin:<name>. Its speech end (threshold speech_end_threshold_db) sets the cue length.

dur_s.description: Cue length in seconds when there is no audio.

text.description: Caption text, kept in the cue.

who.description: Speaker name, used to group the per-speaker voice envelope.

pause_s.description: Seconds before this line; overrides gap_s for this line (ignored on the first line).

tempo.description: Playback speed of the line (default 1). The cue lasts speech_end / tempo seconds.

speech_end_threshold_db.description: dBFS threshold that marks the end of speech in an audio line (default -40).

markers.description: Named markers: each names the scene it sits on and what the music grid should align to there.

scene.description: Id of the scene this marker sits on.

align.description: What a marker aligns to when it is named by align_to: a bar line (bar), a beat (beat) or nothing (none). Default bar.

align_to.description: Name of the marker whose alignment sets the global music_offset_s (beatOffset). Other markers report their bar index with that offset.

times.description: Named times resolved against the computed timeline, e.g. {"hit": "b#0.end-0.1"}.

envelope.description: Optional per-frame voice loudness for the picture to react to. Only audio lines contribute.

fps.description: Frames per second of the envelope.

normalize.description: peak = scale so the loudest frame is gain; none = raw RMS. Default peak.

per_speaker.description: true = voices keyed by who; false = a single voice array. Default true.

extra.description: Fields copied verbatim into the root of timeline.json (name, size, fps, fonts, poster...).
